fields.label: Hero Subtitle
fields.name: hero_subtitle
fields.default_value: Strategic communications advisor and award-winning documentary filmmaker helping organizations build durable narrative infrastructure, unite diverse stakeholders, and accelerate systemic change.

fields.label: Lead Paragraph
fields.name: chapter1_lead
fields.default_value: As founder of the American Resilience Project (ARP), Roger has spent over 30 years pioneering narrative strategies that unite disparate stakeholders around shared solutions.

fields.label: Story Paragraph 1
fields.name: chapter1_story1
fields.default_value: In an era of acute polarization and communication fatigue, high-stakes organizations often struggle to translate complex science, energy policy, and national security data into narratives that resonate. Roger bridges this gap by discovering the underlying human truths that move people from skepticism to consensus.

fields.label: Stat Callout Description
fields.name: chapter1_stat_desc
fields.default_value: Screening events engaging over 2,900 policymakers to achieve concrete bipartisan policy advancements on climate, energy, and national defense.

fields.label: Story Paragraph 2
fields.name: chapter1_story2
fields.default_value: Moving beyond conventional public relations, Roger equips leadership teams with the narrative cornerstones needed to navigate regulatory friction and convert critical initiatives into measurable, long-term impact.

fields.label: Heading Line 1
fields.name: chapter2_line1
fields.default_value: From America's Heartland to West Point:

fields.label: Lead Paragraph
fields.name: chapter2_lead
fields.default_value: Through his strategic communications advisory, Roger brings this narrative expertise directly to organizations navigating complex challenges across defense, infrastructure, agriculture, clean energy, and public health.

fields.label: Impact Card 1 Text
fields.name: chapter2_card1_text
fields.default_value: When leadership pushed back on "another corporate video," Roger engineered an enterprise-wide narrative architecture unifying sustainability and operational pride across 10,000 employees.

fields.label: Impact Card 2 Text
fields.name: chapter2_card2_text
fields.default_value: Bridged deep partisan divides by centering authentic farmer voices, transforming regulatory friction into bipartisan legislative support for resilient agricultural policy.

fields.label: Impact Card 3 Text
fields.name: chapter2_card3_text
fields.default_value: Reframed clean energy and grid resilience as vital operational vulnerabilities for military leadership at West Point and the Pentagon, directly helping secure key defense appropriations.

fields.label: Lead Paragraph
fields.name: chapter3_lead
fields.default_value: Roger's methodology draws from ethnographic research and documentary filmmaking, shaped by his studies in Anthropology at Johns Hopkins University and Communication at Stanford.

fields.label: Story Paragraph 1
fields.name: chapter3_story1
fields.default_value: Before founding ARP, Roger produced award-winning content for National Geographic and PBS: foundational experiences that taught him how to uncover stories that resonate on deeper human levels. He has taught at business schools, led immersive simulations for executives at Fordham University, and moderated high-level forums with government and industry leaders.

fields.label: Story Paragraph 2
fields.name: chapter3_story2
fields.default_value: When not working with clients, Roger coaches youth baseball in Western Massachusetts, finding that building team cohesion on the field offers surprising, practical insights that translate directly to executive communications strategy.

fields.label: Section Title
fields.name: principles_title
fields.default_value: Three Principles That Guide My Work

fields.label: Section Subtitle
fields.name: principles_subtitle
fields.default_value: My approach to communication challenges is guided by three core principles developed across three decades of filmmaking and executive strategy:

fields.label: Principle 1 Text
fields.name: principle_1_text
fields.default_value: People don't need to share identical values to support the same initiative. By identifying where different interests naturally converge, we can build support from stakeholders who might otherwise remain divided.

fields.label: Principle 2 Title
fields.name: principle_2_title
fields.default_value: Emotion Matters as Much as Data

fields.label: Principle 2 Text
fields.name: principle_2_text
fields.default_value: While facts are important, emotional connections create more meaningful relationships with audiences. Authentic storytelling that connects on human levels drives action more effectively than statistics alone.

fields.label: Principle 3 Text
fields.name: principle_3_text
fields.default_value: Communication isn't just what you say: it's the connection between what you do with why you do it. When organizations develop coherent narratives, both internal alignment and external engagement improve dramatically.

fields.label: Methodology Subtitle
fields.name: approach_subtitle
fields.default_value: Every engagement follows a structured, ethnographic methodology ensuring that strategy is deeply grounded in human reality and client mission.

fields.label: Step 1 Description
fields.name: approach_step_1_text
fields.default_value: I begin each engagement with a thorough assessment of your communication ecosystem: who you're trying to reach, what you're saying, and where you're getting stuck. This ethnographic process helps me understand your organization's unique culture and challenges before developing any strategic recommendations.

fields.label: Step 2 Description
fields.name: approach_step_2_text
fields.default_value: My style combines filmmaking expertise with strategic communications knowledge. Whether I'm directing a documentary that captures your mission or designing a comprehensive communications plan, I focus on finding authentic stories that connect with your stakeholders on both emotional and intellectual levels.

fields.label: Step 3 Description
fields.name: approach_step_3_text
fields.default_value: I work directly with clients throughout the entire process, from initial concept development through final delivery. This hands-on approach ensures consistency of vision and allows me to adapt quickly as projects evolve. You'll always work with me personally, not a rotating team of associates who might lose sight of your objectives.
